newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bomb kills pro-Israeli militiaman in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Bomb kills pro-Israeli militiaman in Lebanon.

text.p: A roadside bomb killed a member of the pro-Israeli South Lebanon Army militia and wounded two others on Sunday in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, Israel Radio said.
The army said it was checking the report.
The radio said the bomb went off beside an SLA convoy.
Israel set up its 15 km (9 mile)-wide occupation zone in south Lebanon in 1985 when it withdrew the bulk of its 1982 invasion force.
SLA soldiers patrol the zone in coordination with Israel.
Guerrilla groups, principally Hizbollah (Party of God), are fighting to oust Israel from the zone.
